# Alternatives to ChatGPT Plus

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

ChatGPT Plus is $19.99 a month in the App Store ($20 on OpenAI's site). Most people looking for an alternative want one of three things: a cheaper plan, a different maker's model, or several makers' models for one price. Here are the honest options.

## The options

1. **[ChatGPT](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6448311069)** (OpenAI): best for staying with OpenAI for less. ChatGPT Go, at $8.00 in the App Store's list, is OpenAI's own cheaper plan: the simplest switch if you like ChatGPT and want to pay less. *Price (US): ChatGPT Go $8.00, ChatGPT Plus $19.99, ChatGPT Pro from $100 (in-app purchase list); Plus is $20 a month on OpenAI's site (3 November 2026).*

2. **[Claude by Anthropic](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6473753684)** (Anthropic): best for writing, coding and long thinking. Anthropic's own app, with Claude's newest models first and connectors to Google Drive, Gmail and Calendar. *Price (US): Claude Pro $20.00 a month or $214.99 a year, Claude Max $124.99 a month, Claude Ultra $249.99 a month (in-app purchase list).*

3. **[Google Gemini](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6477489729)** (Google): best for people who live in Google's apps. Gemini connects to Gmail, Calendar, Photos and YouTube, and Google AI Pro includes Google storage. *Price (US): Google AI Plus $4.99, Google AI Pro $19.99, Google AI Ultra $199.99 (in-app purchase list; the plans include Google storage).*

4. **[Perplexity](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1668000334)** (Perplexity AI): best for research with sources. Every answer comes with citations, and Pro adds deeper research tools. *Price (US): Perplexity Pro $20.00 (also listed at $200.00), Perplexity Max $200.00, credit packs from $5.00 (in-app purchase list).*

5. **[Poe](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1640745955)** (Quora): best for the widest choice. Many models and a million custom bots, from $4.99 a month. *Price (US): Basic $4.99 a month or $49.99 a year, Plus $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year (in-app purchase list); usage is counted in points.*

6. **[Omnimo](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891)** (made by the team behind this site): best for several makers' models in one chat. GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more, switchable mid-chat, with Apple Intelligence free on the device and no account. *Price (US): free to start; $6.99 a week (3-day free trial), $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year (1-week free trial). US prices; the app shows the price for your country.*

Ratings, prices and features: each app's US App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, read 25 November 2026. The App Store lists in-app purchases without their billing period; where a listing doesn't say, neither do we.

## How we chose

We list apps we have looked at closely, with what their own listings say. We make Omnimo, so it is on every list; we have tried to say plainly when another app is the better choice.

## Questions

### What is the cheapest alternative to ChatGPT Plus?

Among the options here, Poe Basic is $4.99 a month and ChatGPT Go $8.00 in the US App Store (25 November 2026). Omnimo is free to start, with unlimited Apple Intelligence on supported devices, and Omnimo Pro is $9.99 a month.

### Is there an app with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in one subscription?

Yes, several: Omnimo, Poe, ChatNow and Fello AI among them. Omnimo offers OpenAI's GPT-6, Anthropic's Claude and Google's Gemini: the makers' models, used through pay-per-token APIs, not the ChatGPT app.
